description: 2 imperial gills in imperial fluid ounces
source: Basis: grams (mass), millilitres (volume), pieces (count). 2 imp-gill * 142.0653125 / 28.4130625 = 10 imp-floz (1 gill = 1/4 pint, 1 fluid ounce = 1/20 pint, so 1 gill = 5 fluid ounces). Unit factors: docs/engine-rules.md#units-and-factors (imperial capacity units: Weights and Measures Act 1985, Schedule 1, Part IV, legislation.gov.uk, read 2026-11-19).
